# Wondermayank - Creator Portfolio & Ecosystem

> Official developer, designer, and creator portfolio of Wondermayank (Mayank), accessible at https://about.wondermayank.in

## About Wondermayank
Wondermayank (Mayank) is an independent Indian full-stack software developer, 3D web creator, and educator who designs and builds high-performance web applications, educational platforms, and creative web experiments.

## Core Platforms & Ecosystem Links
- **About / Portfolio**: [about.wondermayank.in](https://about.wondermayank.in/) - 3D interactive portfolio, creative journey, and platform hub.
- **Main Website & Contact**: [wondermayank.in](https://wondermayank.in/) | [Contact](https://wondermayank.in/contact.html)
- **ThunderStudy**: [thunderstudy.indevs.in](https://thunderstudy.indevs.in/) - Open educational hub providing structured study notes, flashcards, and revision guides for Indian exams.
- **ThunderTest**: [thundertest.indevs.in](https://thundertest.indevs.in/) - CBT (Computer Based Test) examination simulator replicating the official NTA candidate interface for CUET, JEE Main, NEET, SSC, and Banking exams.
- **Projects Hub**: [project.wondermayank.in](https://project.wondermayank.in/) - Directory of 100+ creative web tools, utilities, anime search engines, and interactive modules.
- **Paletteify**: [project.wondermayank.in/paletteify/](https://project.wondermayank.in/paletteify/) - High-utility color palette engine with WCAG contrast testing and Tailwind CSS exports.
- **Periodic Table 3D**: [project.wondermayank.in/Periodic-Table/](https://project.wondermayank.in/Periodic-Table/) - Interactive 3D periodic table of elements with electron orbital visualizations.

## Key Specializations & Tech Stack
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- 3D & Graphics: Three.js, WebGL, tsparticles, canvas-based shaders
- EdTech & CBT: Full-fledged exam simulation engines, scoring algorithms, and question palettes
- Social & Code: [GitHub](https://github.com/wondermayank) | [Twitter / X](https://twitter.com/wonder_mayank) | [Instagram](https://instagram.com/wondermayank)
